title: Relief on a Car Rental Excess Mileage Settlement for a Membership Driven On
content:
A traveller club membership that the renter has actually driven on relieves the excess mileage settlement on a rental of the Car Rental Rate Classes. The membership is the one standing in the renter's name with the Wanderlane Traveller Club, and what it has been driven on is read from the rental accruals standing on its points ledger over the last twenty-four months.

**The relief schedule.**

| The membership standing in the renter's name | Relieved at |
|---|---|
| Active at Wanderlane Titanium or Wanderlane Ambassador, with at least 2 rental accruals on its points ledger over the last twenty-four months | 25 percent |
| Active at Wanderlane Gold or Wanderlane Platinum, with at least 2 rental accruals on its points ledger over the last twenty-four months | 10 percent |
| Any other membership, or none | Nothing |

The relief is taken off the amount the settlement stands at when the relief is applied. The accruals counted are those raised on the points ledger from car rental over the twenty-four months preceding the handling date; accruals from another source, and accruals older than twenty-four months, are not counted.

**Both parts of each condition.** A membership at Wanderlane Ambassador carrying 2 rental accruals in that period is relieved at 25 percent; the same membership carrying 1 is relieved at nothing, since the second entitlement names other tiers. A membership at Wanderlane Platinum carrying 5 rental accruals is relieved at 10 percent. A membership at Wanderlane Silver is named in neither entitlement and is relieved at nothing, however many rental accruals stand on its points ledger, and so is a membership that is not active.

**The boundary on the count.** At exactly 2 rental accruals in the last twenty-four months the relief stands, the entitlement turning on at least that many; at 1 it does not.
